posts.title: WELCOME TO THE WORKSHOP
posts.text:
The home of **GD's Melee**: a native PC port with rollback netplay, mod support, Lua scripting, and the LAB.

**Start playing**
Read #rules, then grab the build in #downloads.

**Find your people**
Introduce yourself in #introductions, find a set in #matchmaking, and share your best work in #clips-and-creations.

**Get help or get involved**
Setup questions → #help-and-setup
Reproducible problems → #bug-reports
Practice and experiments → #training-and-lab
Mods and scripts → #modding-and-scripting

Use **Channels & Roles** to choose Player, Modder, or Playtester. You can pick more than one.

**New here?** Your main, a broad region, and what you want to try are a good first introduction.

posts.title: WORKSHOP RULES
posts.text:
**1 · Treat people well.** No harassment, hate speech, threats, doxxing, or targeted dogpiling. Respect boundaries in chat, voice, and DMs.

**2 · Keep it safe to open.** No sexually explicit content, graphic violence, scams, malware, or deceptive downloads.

**3 · Share your work responsibly.** No game ISOs, ROMs, extracted game assets, or links to obtain them. Share original work, source, and patches with appropriate credits and permissions.

**4 · Keep channels useful.** No spam, unsolicited advertising, mass mentions, or repeated bumps. Put help requests in #help-and-setup and reproducible bugs in #bug-reports.

**5 · Play fair.** Agree on the build, rules, and mods before a set. No cheating, griefing, or deliberate disruption.

**6 · Protect private information.** Remove personal paths, addresses, tokens, and other secrets from logs before sharing. Never ask someone for their password or token.

**Need a moderator?** Use Discord's message reporting tools for platform violations, or contact the owner / a Moderator with the message link. Avoid public callouts. Moderators may remove content, time out, or remove members when needed.

posts.title: PROJECT UPDATES
posts.text:
This channel is for official builds, release notes, and important Workshop updates.

**Latest build and setup:** #downloads
**Questions:** #help-and-setup
**Bug reports:** #bug-reports

GD's Melee is a public test project. Include your build version when discussing behavior; fixes and compatibility can change between builds.

Server notifications default to mentions only. Follow this channel if you want release updates.

posts.title: GET GD'S MELEE
posts.text:
**Official downloads**
[Latest Windows release](https://github.com/GurekamDhillon/gd-melee-workspace/releases/latest) · [Source and README](https://github.com/GurekamDhillon/gd-melee-workspace)

**First launch**
1. Download the Windows ZIP from the release's **Assets** section and extract it.
2. Run **GD Melee.exe**. Choose **Add disc...** and select your own Melee NTSC 1.02 disc image. Compatible mod discs can be selected too.
3. Press **PLAY**. The release includes the port, not game data.

**Online play**
Open **VERSUS → ONLINE**. Host a room and share its code, join a friend's room, or use **Random Opponent**. Match the build and disc/mod content with your opponent.

**Need a hand?** Open a post in #help-and-setup. Include your build, Windows version, GPU, controller, and the exact error. Never upload a disc image.

posts.text:

posts.title: SUGGESTIONS
posts.text:
Use this format for suggestions:
**Problem:** What gets in your way?
**Idea:** What would make it better?
**Example:** When would you use it?

Keep one idea per message and discuss it in a thread. Reactions show interest; they do not promise an implementation date. Bugs go in #bug-reports.

posts.title: FIND YOUR NEXT SET
posts.text:
Post a short lobby listing:
**Region / connection:** broad region; wired or Wi-Fi
**Build + content:** version and vanilla / mod pack
**Room code:** your in-game room
**Looking for:** friendlies, practice, or a longer set

Both players should use matching builds and content. Agree on any mods or rules before starting. Use **Friendlies 1** or **Friendlies 2** for voice and edit your post when the room closes.

Connection trouble? Open a **Netplay** post in #help-and-setup.

posts.title: TRAINING & LAB
posts.text:
Share practice routines, dummy setups, matchup questions, and reproducible experiments.

For LAB discussions, include your build, fighters, stage, starting situation, and the setting or drill you used. Label measured results and theories clearly.

Use **SOLO → LAB** for the port's practice tools. If something behaves incorrectly, open a reproducible report in #bug-reports.

posts.title: MODS & SCRIPTS
posts.text:
Talk m-ex compatibility, Lua scripts, kit UI, and original additions for GD's Melee.

[Scripting guide](https://github.com/GurekamDhillon/gd-melee-workspace/blob/master/docs/scripting.md) · [Workspace source](https://github.com/GurekamDhillon/gd-melee-workspace)

When asking for help, include the build, mod pack, relevant code, error, and the smallest steps that reproduce it. Use code blocks and thread longer investigations.

Share source and patches, credit collaborators, and check permissions before redistributing someone else's work. Game discs and extracted assets stay off the server.

posts.title: STAFF DESK
posts.text:
This category is visible to the owner, the setup bot, and Moderator roles only. Contributor, Player, Modder, and Playtester do not grant staff access.

**Roles:** assign Moderator only to trusted staff. Contributor is recognition; the three interest roles are self-selectable in Channels & Roles.

**Moderation:** AutoMod reports to #mod-alerts; Discord notices go to #discord-updates. Review context, keep a message link, and explain actions briefly.

The setup bot uses Discord's API and may appear offline. Native AutoMod and onboarding continue without a running bot service. No reaction-role or ticket bot is required.
